option.name: --all-lines
tip: Print all source lines in annotated output.

option.name: --annotated-source
tip: Print annotated source code; the optional symspec filters symbols.

option.name: --brief
tip: Do not print the verbose explanatory blurbs.

option.name: --debug
tip: Enable debugging output; the optional num sets the level.

option.name: --demangle
tip: Demangle C++ symbol names.

option.name: --directory-path
tip: Add search directories for source files.

option.name: --display-unused-functions
tip: Display functions that were never called.

option.name: --exec-counts
tip: Print a tally of functions and their call counts.

option.name: --external-symbol-table
tip: Read the external symbol table from the file.

option.name: --file-format
tip: Use the specified file format.

option.name: --file-info
tip: Display summary information about the profile data files and exit.

option.name: --file-ordering
tip: Print a suggested file ordering based on the call graph.

option.name: --flat-profile
tip: Print a flat profile; the optional symspec filters symbols.

option.name: --function-ordering
tip: Print a suggested function ordering based on profiling data.

option.name: --graph
tip: Print the call graph; the optional symspec filters symbols.

option.name: --help
tip: Display this information.

option.name: --ignore-non-functions
tip: Ignore symbols that are not functions.

option.name: --inline-file-names
tip: Print inline file names.

option.name: --line
tip: Use line-by-line profiling.

option.name: --min-count
tip: Only print entries with at least num calls.

option.name: --no-annotated-source
tip: Do not print annotated source code; the optional symspec excludes symbols.

option.name: --no-demangle
tip: Do not demangle C++ symbol names.

option.name: --no-exec-counts
tip: Do not print the function call tally; the optional symspec excludes symbols.

option.name: --no-flat-profile
tip: Suppress the flat profile; the optional symspec excludes symbols.

option.name: --no-graph
tip: Suppress the call graph; the optional symspec excludes symbols.

option.name: --no-static
tip: Do not print static function entries in the call graph.

option.name: --no-time
tip: Exclude matching symbols from the time calculation.

option.name: --print-path
tip: Print the full pathname of source filenames.

option.name: --separate-files
tip: Write annotated source for each file into filename-ann.

option.name: --static-call-graph
tip: Print a static call graph.

option.name: --sum
tip: Merge the profile data into gmon.sum.

option.name: --table-length
tip: List the num most active source lines per file (default 10).

option.name: --time
tip: Print only the time for matching symbols.

option.name: --traditional
tip: Use the traditional BSD output format.

option.name: --version
tip: Display the version number.

option.name: --width
tip: Set the output width.

option.name: -B
tip: Print the call graph analysis.

option.name: -e
tip: Do not print the named function and its children in the call graph.

option.name: -E
tip: Like -e, and exclude the time from the call graph percentages.

option.name: -f
tip: Limit the call graph to the named function and its children.

option.name: -F
tip: Like -f, and use only that function's time for percentages.

option.name: -k
tip: Exclude functions between the from and to addresses.
